subject: Show Which Accounts Are Currently Connected to Shiny Apps

messages.author: 190eaa109030602b
messages.subject: Show Which Accounts Are Currently Connected to Shiny Apps
parts:
Hi all,

Just wonder if it's possible to show which accounts are currently connected to shiny apps on shinyapps.io? As our dashboard has "save data" function, we might need to warn people their changes might be affected by others.

Thank you,
Jeremy

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Show Which Accounts Are Currently Connected to Shiny Apps
parts:
There's not a great way to do this on ShinyApps.io, only because by default it runs your app on potentially multiple machines/processes. If all the users were connecting to one process on one machine then you could easily keep a reactiveValues object with global scope (e.g. in server.R but above the shiny server function itself). Then in the shiny server function you could add session$user to the shared object, and use session$onSessionEnded (see ?session) to remove that session$user from the shared object.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scoping.html
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/permissions.html
